Title: Extract knowledge and upload
Description: As a desktop user, I want to extract knowledge from prepared units and upload them to Cortexa so that the platform can find patent candidates. The app implements the untrusted source guard, loads the knowledge prompt resource, builds structured JSON prompts, calls an AI provider, parses responses, locates anchors in source files, merges duplicates, and uploads batches via POST /collector/batches/knowledge. A review screen filters and deselects items.
AcceptanceCriteria: Untrusted source guard neutralizes user input and adds security sentinels
Knowledge prompt (knowledge-prompt.v1.json) is loaded from embedded resources
Prompt builder creates structured JSON (what/why/how) for each unit
Claude direct provider uses the official Anthropic C# SDK
Gemini direct provider uses the official Google Gen AI .NET SDK with the API key from Credential Manager; provider is selected by Ai:Provider (Claude | Gemini) and Claude remains supported
Response parser extracts items from JSON; empty responses are allowed
Anchor locator verifies anchor_quote by substring search; falls back to unit range
Merger deduplicates knowledge items by kind + title within a document
Review screen shows items by kind; users can deselect before upload
Upload client sends batches to the collector server POST /collector/batches/knowledge with Idempotency-Key
End-to-end check: pick a local folder, extract knowledge, upload, and verify chunks in Cosmos
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: Extracting knowledge from document units using Claude (Anthropic SDK) or Gemini (Google Gen AI SDK) with provider selection, implementing the untrusted source guard, merging duplicates, and uploading batches to Cortexa. Building review and history screens. Full integration with POST /batches/knowledge endpoint.

Tasks.Title: Implement untrusted source guard and prompt builder
Tasks.Description: Re-implement the backend neutralization logic inside the collector; load knowledge-prompt.v1.json; build structured JSON with unit metadata.

Tasks.Title: Integrate Anthropic C# SDK for Claude
Tasks.Description: Set up the official SDK, handle API keys from Credential Manager, implement retry logic and error handling.

Tasks.Title: Build IAiProvider port and Claude provider implementation
Tasks.Description: Create interface for AI providers; implement Claude provider with concurrency 4, temperature left at the model default (claude-sonnet-5-5 rejects non-default temperature; configurable via Ai:Claude:Temperature), max output 8192 tokens.

Tasks.Title: Add Gemini direct provider
Tasks.Description: Implement Gemini provider using the official Google Gen AI .NET SDK with API key from Credential Manager; support provider selection via Ai:Provider config setting (Claude | Gemini).

Tasks.Title: Implement response parser and anchor locator
Tasks.Description: Parse JSON response; extract knowledge items; verify anchor_quote by substring search; fall back to unit range.

Tasks.Title: Build knowledge merger for deduplication
Tasks.Description: Merge items with same kind + title within a document; consolidate sources and excerpts.

Tasks.Title: Create review screen and upload client
Tasks.Description: UI to filter/deselect items by kind; upload client sends POST /collector/batches/knowledge with Idempotency-Key; handle responses.

Tests.Title: Knowledge extraction returns expected item structure

Steps.Action: Extract knowledge from a sample unit
Steps.Expected: Response contains items with kind, title, summary, details, source, excerpt, provider, model

Steps.Action: Extract item with anchor_quote and verify it in original file
Steps.Expected: Anchor is found; line_range is narrowed to location

Steps.Action: Extract two units that produce items with same kind + title
Steps.Expected: Only one merged item appears in review

Steps.Action: Display review screen and deselect one item
Steps.Expected: Deselected item is not included in upload

Steps.Action: Start native Cortexa stack with: pwsh -NoProfile -File Cortexa-dev/deploy/local/native/run-local.ps1 start. Also start the collector server separately on localhost:5091
Steps.Expected: All services start; gateway is listening on localhost:5080 and collector server on localhost:5091

Steps.Action: Sign in to desktop collector and pick a local folder (e.g., a small repo or sample docs)
Steps.Expected: Files are parsed into units; unit count and token preview are shown

Steps.Action: Click Extract Knowledge and review items by kind
Steps.Expected: Knowledge items appear with logic/algorithm/method/data_model/interface/workflow/key_content kinds (layer kind arrives with US130/US131); each has title, summary, details
POST /collector/batches/knowledge is called; batch_id is returned

Steps.Action: Check Cosmos emulator Data Explorer at https://localhost:8081/_explorer; navigate to chunks container
Steps.Expected: New rows have knowledge field populated with extracted items; no original file content is present

Steps.Action: Verify MinIO object browser at http://localhost:9001
Steps.Expected: No original files stored in buckets; only metadata

ReviewNotes.note: Code review of develop/US126 confirms all 12 acceptance criteria are met, including the Gemini direct provider. The prior commit message ('Gemini implementation is in halfway') is stale: GeminiDirectProvider, GeminiClientFactory, GeminiRequestFactory, GeminiResponseReader, GeminiErrorMapper and GeminiProviderOptionsValidator are complete against the official Google.GenAI SDK (v1.24.0, verified official on nuget.org), registered in DI alongside ClaudeDirectProvider (official Anthropic SDK v12.53.0), and both provider paths are covered by tests (DependencyInjectionTests.AiProvider_ProviderSetting_ResolvesMatchingImplementation, AiProvider_BothImplementations_AreBuildable). No blockers found. Non-blocking note: appsettings.json model IDs ('claude-sonnet-5-5', 'gemini-3.8-flash') look like placeholders and should be confirmed against the live provider APIs before shipping.
